drafts.subject: Testnet date and runbook for your evaluation team
drafts.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for your patience. We have heard you ask twice and we want to give you a real answer, not another placeholder.

We are targeting [testnet date] for a self-contained testnet your security team can run without a QuFi engineer in the room. Before we hand that over, we are working through every step in the current setup that requires us to intervene, commands that fail silently, dependencies that are not written down, configuration values that only exist in someone's head. We are closing each one before we send you anything.

What you will receive by [runbook delivery date]:
- A runbook your team can follow start to finish on your own infrastructure
- A defined pass/fail criterion for each test so the evaluation has a clear outcome
- A single point of contact for questions during the run

We will confirm the testnet date by [confirmation date].

The one thing that would help us right now: can you tell us who on your side will lead the technical evaluation? That lets us make sure the runbook speaks directly to how your team works.

Happy to get on a short call this week if that is easier.

[Your name]
QuFi
